other_interfaces.description: User-configured MCP Streamable HTTP endpoints, OAuth discovery/registration/token URLs, WebSocket servers, and stdio subprocess JSON-RPC. Only first-party Apps /ps/mcp is a fixed backend route.

App-server JSON-RPC over stdio, Unix domain socket, local/user-configured authenticated WebSocket; not an upstream OpenAI HTTP API. Full remote-control tunnel carries the messages without implementing each RPC.
Exec-server gRPC/JSON-RPC, platform sandbox IPC, voice-host/WebRTC media, code-mode gRPC execution and thread-config gRPC load are local or user-provisioned runtime services.
AWS Bedrock Mantle/runtime use AWS/SigV4; Ollama/LMStudio local endpoints use separate auth. They are unrelated to ChatGPT subscription auth and arbitrary provider base URLs are not an OpenAI origin.

GitHub openai/plugins repo/ref/zipball; GitHub openai/codex releases, npm registry package metadata, Homebrew metadata, and configured Git marketplaces/downloads. Static/software distribution, no subscription auth.
ChatGPT app install pages, OAuth login browser pages, billing/help links, desktop deep links are browser navigation rather than direct backend HTTP request APIs.
User-configured OTLP HTTP/gRPC exporters and local OTLP/trace WebSocket bridges may use arbitrary collector URLs.
External subject-token/STS attestation sources depend on configured workload identity provider; OpenAI token exchange lands on auth /oauth/token already inventoried.

origin_mappings.signed_url: Only URLs returned by authenticated first-party APIs, retain their exact signature query; never attach account auth.

proxy_notes: Use one raw HTTP/WS transport with route metadata rather than duplicate request/response DTOs for each native API. Preserve raw body, query, end-to-end request and response headers, status and stream chunks.

First-party backend routes use original AuthProvider + original HttpClientFactory cookie behavior. Authorization/ChatGPT-Account-ID/Fedramp belong to active upstream account; a separate gateway credential must be stripped.
Preserve Content-Encoding including zstd; do not decode then silently emit unchanged compressed Content-Length. Drop hop-by-hop headers and regenerate upgrade transport fields.
Remote enrollment token routes, personal access token, API-key billing, OAuth body flows and signed URLs each use distinct auth modes. Blanket subscription substitution is incorrect.

Only original infrastructure cookie jar persists Cloudflare cookies + __oailb; do not synthesize CSRF headers or browser session cookies, which Codex does not send. Configured additional cookies are scoped by original HttpClientFactory.
Responses compact/lite do not exist as original paths in this pinned release source; gateway compatibility adapters may offer them, but must not inventory them as original Codex endpoints.

chatgpt_base_url must be configured as gateway/backend-api separately from model provider base_url. Some callers also gate on cached Codex-backend auth; model provider actor marker alone does not enable every service.

Original remote-control URL normalization rejects arbitrary nonlocalhost gateway hosts; localhost forwarder or a minimal original-source configuration patch is required for remote-control at K8s domain.

Standalone audio/transcriptions HTTP route is absent in this release; transcription runs inside Realtime audio.input.transcription. A new /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint would be an actual conversion/orchestration, not native path passthrough.
